```{r dash-executive-summary, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
library(dplyr)
library(htmltools)

# ============================================================
# RUN METADATA
# ============================================================

test_meta <- raw_data %>%
  group_by(run_id) %>%
  summarise(
    sequence_num = first(sequence_num),
    project_name = first(project_name),
    test_name    = first(test_name),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

current_run <- test_meta %>%
  filter(sequence_num == max(sequence_num))

baseline_run <- test_meta %>%
  filter(sequence_num == min(sequence_num))

current_run_id  <- current_run$run_id[1]
baseline_run_id <- baseline_run$run_id[1]

project_name  <- current_run$project_name[1]
scenario_name <- current_run$test_name[1]

# ============================================================
# OVERALL RESULT
# ============================================================

overall_status <- get_run_sla_status(current_run_id)

overall_result <- if (isTRUE(overall_status)) {
  "<span class='status-pass'>PASS</span>"
} else {
  "<span class='status-fail'>FAIL</span>"
}

summary_class <- if (isTRUE(overall_status)) {
  "executive-summary"
} else {
  "executive-summary fail"
}

overall_icon <- if (isTRUE(overall_status)) {
  "✅"
} else {
  "❌"
}

# ============================================================
# BASIC SLA STATUS + ACTUAL VS TARGET
# ============================================================

current_key <- as.character(current_run_id)

vu_status <- "N/A"
tp_status <- "N/A"
er_status <- "N/A"

vu_actual <- "-"
vu_target <- "-"

tp_actual <- "-"
tp_target <- "-"

er_actual <- "-"
er_target <- "-"

if (!is.null(sla_results[[current_key]])) {

  run_rules <- sla_results[[current_key]]$rules

  get_rule <- function(metric_name) {

    rule <- Filter(
      function(x) identical(x$metric, metric_name),
      run_rules
    )

    if (length(rule) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    rule[[1]]
  }

  # ============================================================
  # Virtual Users
  # ============================================================

  vu_rule <- get_rule("total_users")

  if (!is.null(vu_rule)) {

    vu_status <- ifelse(
      isTRUE(vu_rule$passed),
      "PASS",
      "FAIL"
    )

    vu_actual <- format(
      round(vu_rule$actual, 0),
      big.mark = ","
    )

    vu_target <- paste0(
      vu_rule$operator,
      " ",
      vu_rule$threshold
    )
  }

  # ============================================================
  # Throughput
  # ============================================================

  tp_rule <- get_rule("throughput")

  if (!is.null(tp_rule)) {

    tp_status <- ifelse(
      isTRUE(tp_rule$passed),
      "PASS",
      "FAIL"
    )

    tp_actual <- paste0(
      tp_rule$actual,
      " ",
      tp_rule$unit
    )

    tp_target <- paste0(
      tp_rule$operator,
      " ",
      tp_rule$threshold,
      " ",
      tp_rule$unit
    )
  }

  # ============================================================
  # Error Rate
  # ============================================================

  er_rule <- get_rule("error_rate")

  if (!is.null(er_rule)) {

    er_status <- ifelse(
      isTRUE(er_rule$passed),
      "PASS",
      "FAIL"
    )

    er_actual <- paste0(
      er_rule$actual,
      "%"
    )

    er_target <- paste0(
      er_rule$operator,
      " ",
      er_rule$threshold,
      "%"
    )
  }
}

# ============================================================
# RESPONSE TIME SLA (USER JOURNEY LEVEL)
# ============================================================

rt_summary <- get_run_rt_sla(current_run_id)

journey_sla_summary <- NULL

journey_passed <- 0
journey_total  <- 0
journey_failed <- 0
rt_status      <- "N/A"

if (!is.null(rt_summary)) {

  journey_sla_summary <- rt_summary$all_labels %>%
    left_join(
      raw_data %>%
        filter(run_id == current_run_id) %>%
        distinct(label, thread_group),
      by = "label"
    ) %>%
    group_by(thread_group) %>%
    summarise(
      passed = all(passed),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  journey_passed <- sum(
    journey_sla_summary$passed,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  journey_total <- nrow(
    journey_sla_summary
  )

  journey_failed <- journey_total - journey_passed

  rt_status <- if (
    journey_failed == 0
  ) {
    "PASS"
  } else {
    "FAIL"
  }
}

# ============================================================
# TOP BREACHES
# ============================================================

breach_section <- ""

if (!is.null(rt_summary) &&
    rt_summary$failed_count > 0) {

  top_breaches <- head(
    rt_summary$top_breaches,
    10
  )

  breach_items <- paste(
    sprintf(
      "<li>%s (%s%% breach)</li>",
      top_breaches$label,
      top_breaches$breach_pct
    ),
    collapse = ""
  )

  breach_section <- paste0(
    "<hr/>",
    "<b>Top SLA Breaches</b>",
    "<ul>",
    breach_items,
    "</ul>"
  )
}

# ============================================================
# SLA STATUS COLOURS
# ============================================================

status_class <- function(x) {

  if (x == "PASS") {
    return("status-pass")
  }

  if (x == "FAIL") {
    return("status-fail")
  }

  "status-na"
}

# ============================================================
# PRIMARY FAILURE DRIVERS
# ============================================================

failure_items <- c()

if (tp_status == "FAIL") {
  failure_items <- c(
    failure_items,
    sprintf(
      "Throughput below SLA target (%s vs %s)",
      tp_actual,
      tp_target
    )
  )
}

if (er_status == "FAIL") {
  failure_items <- c(
    failure_items,
    sprintf(
      "Error Rate exceeded SLA (%s vs %s)",
      er_actual,
      er_target
    )
  )
}

if (vu_status == "FAIL") {
  failure_items <- c(
    failure_items,
    sprintf(
      "Virtual User target not met (%s vs %s)",
      vu_actual,
      vu_target
    )
  )
}

if (rt_status == "FAIL") {

  failure_items <- c(
    failure_items,
    sprintf(
      "%s of %s User Journeys failed Response Time SLA",
      journey_failed,
      journey_total
    )
  )
}

failure_section <- ""

if (length(failure_items) > 0) {

  failure_section <- paste0(
    "<hr/>",
    "<div class='failure-drivers'>",
    "<b>Primary Failure Drivers</b>",
    "<ul>",
    paste0("<li>", failure_items, "</li>", collapse = ""),
    "</ul>",
    "</div>"
  )
}

# ============================================================
# TOP BREACHES
# ============================================================

top_breach_section <- ""

if (!is.null(rt_summary) &&
    rt_summary$failed_count > 0) {

  top_breach_section <- paste0(
    "<hr/>",
    "<b>Top Response Time Breaches</b>",
    "<ul>",
    paste(
      sprintf(
        "<li>%s<br/><span class='executive-subtext'>Actual: %sms | SLA: %sms | Breach: %s%%</span></li>",
        rt_summary$top_breaches$label,
        rt_summary$top_breaches$actual_rt,
        rt_summary$top_breaches$threshold,
        rt_summary$top_breaches$breach_pct
      ),
      collapse = ""
    ),
    "</ul>"
  )
}

# ============================================================
# HTML
# ============================================================

summary_html <- sprintf(
'
<div class="%s">

<h2>%s OVERALL STATUS: %s</h2>

<p>
<b>Project:</b> %s<br/>
<b>Scenario:</b> %s<br/>
<b>Current Run:</b> %s<br/>
<b>Baseline Run:</b> %s
</p>

<hr/>

<p><b>SLA Summary</b></p>

<table style="width:100%%; border-collapse:collapse;">

<tr>
  <td><b>Virtual Users</b></td>
  <td><span class="%s">%s</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
  <td colspan="2" class="executive-subtext">
    Actual: %s | Target: %s
  </td>
</tr>

<tr>
  <td><b>Throughput (Success)</b></td>
  <td><span class="%s">%s</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
  <td colspan="2" class="executive-subtext">
    Actual: %s | Target: %s
  </td>
</tr>

<tr>
  <td><b>Error Rate</b></td>
  <td><span class="%s">%s</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
  <td colspan="2" class="executive-subtext">
    Actual: %s | Target: %s
  </td>
</tr>

<tr>
  <td><b>Response Time</b></td>
  <td>
    <span class="%s">%s</span>
    (%s of %s User Journeys Passed)
  </td>
</tr>

</table>

%s

%s

</div>
',
summary_class,

overall_icon,
overall_result,

project_name,
scenario_name,

current_run_id,
baseline_run_id,

status_class(vu_status),
vu_status,
vu_actual,
vu_target,

status_class(tp_status),
tp_status,
tp_actual,
tp_target,

status_class(er_status),
er_status,
er_actual,
er_target,

status_class(rt_status),
rt_status,
journey_passed,
journey_total,

failure_section,

top_breach_section
)

HTML(summary_html)
```
